fieldValues.title: The owner's strategy waits as a suggestion with nowhere to affirm it
fieldValues.statement: When I set a group's stance or a domain's axes, I want it in force from then on. Affirmation never happens in chat, so my words become agent suggestions, and the place to affirm them (srs-web#617) does not exist yet. The clerk reads only affirmed records, so what I set is invisible and I set it again.
source_ref: Owner, 2026-10-27: vignette c3413c86 (I have set strategy priority multiple times... we seem to have lost them again)
Owner ruling 2026-10-25, clerk#197 R2: affirmation never happens in chat
